meta.project: SIMSA — Sistem Informasi Manajemen Surat dan Arsip

product_overview: SIMSA is a web application that digitises the end-to-end management of official correspondence and archives for Kementerian ATR/BPN, implementing regulatory forms, retention schedules, and archive lifecycle workflows. The system provides role-based access, reporting, and tools for mail registration, classification, storage tracking and disposition.
core_goals: Digitise and streamline incoming/outgoing letter registration and archive lifecycle in accordance with Permen ATR/BPN regulations
Provide role-based access control and auditability for secure, compliant archive management
Enable fast search, reporting and export (Excel/PDF) for operational and supervisory needs
Support retention scheduling, multi-stage disposition workflows, and physical storage tracking
Offer reliable file handling (uploads/OCR), printable regulatory forms, and integrations (Google OAuth, exports)

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to authenticate using email/password or Google OAuth, with password visibility toggle and clear error messaging on invalid credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See dashboard at /
Navigate to /login -> Click Google Sign-In button -> Complete Google OAuth consent -> Be redirected to / -> See dashboard at /
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See error message on invalid credentials -> Stay on /login
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Toggle password visibility -> Verify password visible -> Click Login button to submit -> See dashboard at /

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated users view KPIs, charts and recent activities to monitor mail and archive trends and unit performance.
user_flows: Be authenticated (active session) -> Navigate to / -> View mail and archive statistics cards -> View charts for mail trends -> See recent activities
Be authenticated (active session) -> Navigate to / -> Use Unit Kerja filter -> See filtered KPI cards and updated charts
Be unauthenticated -> Navigate to / -> Be redirected to /login -> See login page
Be authenticated (active session) -> Navigate to / -> View loading skeletons -> See error message 'Failed to load dashboard' on API failure

features.name: Incoming Mail Management
features.description: List, search, filter, create, edit, view details, upload attachments and delete incoming mails; supports archiving and disposition actions.
user_flows: Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/masuk -> View list of incoming mails -> Search by keyword -> Apply date/status filters -> See filtered list

Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/masuk -> Click add button to create new mail -> Navigate to /surat/masuk/tambah -> Fill in mail form fields -> Upload attachment files -> Submit the form -> See new mail in list at /surat/masuk
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/masuk -> Click to view mail details -> Navigate to /surat/masuk/:id -> See full mail detail view
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/masuk -> Click on a mail's Edit action -> Navigate to /surat/masuk/edit/:id -> Update form fields -> Submit the form -> See updated values in /surat/masuk/:id

Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/masuk/tambah -> Fill in mail form fields (missing required nomor surat) -> Click Submit -> See validation error for required field -> Stay on /surat/masuk/tambah
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/masuk -> Click Delete on a mail -> See deletion confirmation dialog -> Confirm deletion -> See mail removed from list or see error message on server failure

features.name: Outgoing Mail Management
features.description: Manage outgoing letters with full CRUD: list, search, create, view details, edit and delete, including recipient and naskah dinas metadata.
user_flows: Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/keluar -> View list of outgoing mails -> Search and filter mails -> See results

Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/keluar -> Click add button to create new outgoing mail -> Navigate to /surat/keluar/tambah -> Fill in mail form fields -> Upload attachment files -> Submit the form -> See new outgoing mail in list
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/keluar -> Click to view mail details -> Navigate to /surat/keluar/:id -> See full mail detail view
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/keluar -> Click Edit on a mail -> Navigate to /surat/keluar/edit/:id -> Update fields -> Submit -> See updated details
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/keluar/tambah -> Fill in mail form fields (invalid date format) -> Click Submit -> See validation error message -> Stay on /surat/keluar/tambah
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /surat/keluar -> Click Delete on a mail -> See deletion confirmation -> Confirm deletion -> See mail removed or see error message on server failure

features.name: Archive Management
features.description: View and manage archives with tabbed lists (masuk/keluar), search, detail metadata, classification, storage info and lifecycle/retention indicators.
user_flows: Be authenticated -> Navigate to /arsip/:tab -> Switch between archive tabs -> View archive list for selected tab -> See pagination
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /arsip/:tab -> Use Search archives -> See matching archive rows in list
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /arsip/:tab -> Click to view archive details -> Navigate to /arsip/detail/:id -> See archive metadata, classification and storage info
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /arsip/:tab -> Use filters to find archives approaching retention deadline -> Select items for batch review -> See selected count
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /arsip/:tab -> Search with no matching results -> See 'No results' message
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /arsip/:tab -> Attempt to open /arsip/detail/:id for invalid id -> See error message 'Archive not found' or be redirected to /arsip/:tab

features.name: User Management
features.description: Super admin manages user accounts, roles, unit assignment and activation state via a dedicated user management UI.
user_flows: Be authenticated as super_admin -> Navigate to /users -> View user list -> Use search to find a user -> See user details row
Be authenticated as super_admin -> Navigate to /users -> Click Create new user -> Fill user form fields -> Submit form -> See new user in list
Be authenticated as super_admin -> Navigate to /users -> Click Edit on a user -> Update role or unit_kerja -> Submit -> See updated role in list
Be authenticated as non-super_admin -> Navigate to /users -> See access denied or 403 -> Remain on current page or be redirected to /
Be authenticated as super_admin -> Navigate to /users -> Click Deactivate on a user -> Confirm deactivation -> See user marked as deactivated

features.name: Reports
features.description: Generate and export operational and regulatory reports with date filters and multiple export formats (Excel, PDF).
user_flows: Be authenticated -> Navigate to /laporan -> Select report type -> Set date range filters -> Click Generate report -> See report results displayed
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /laporan -> Generate report -> Click Export to Excel -> Download Excel file
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /laporan -> Generate report -> Click Export to PDF -> Download PDF file
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /laporan -> Set invalid date range (end before start) -> Click Generate report -> See validation error and remain on /laporan
Be authenticated -> Navigate to /laporan -> Click Generate report -> See loading indicator -> See error message 'Failed to generate report' on API failure
